Jordan (CSM): quick heads-up — BrightMap flagged a p95 latency spike on embeddings during onboarding window 2026-03-20 14:00-14:20 UTC. They said it affected a renewal convo. I pulled a quick pass of metrics.
Priya (AM): ugh, thanks. Do we have the evidence bundle? customer is asking for SLO impact + credit calc before the sync in 45m.
Kai (SRE): adding details — looks like autoscaler churn + cold kv-cache misses. Query I ran: `SELECT p95_ms, requests FROM telemetry WHERE customer='brightmap' AND route='/v1/embeddings' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T14:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T14:20Z'` — p95 jumped from ~80ms -> 520ms for ~12m of the window.
Jordan (CSM): attached dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/boards/brightmap-onboard?p=embed_p95 (summary below). Will bundle request IDs & traces.
Liam (Eng): looks consistent with a scale-down race where warmup didn't finish before new load. Suggested short-term: bump min-capacity for onboarding pools + enable prefix-warm cache for this customer. Long-term: improve autoscaler smoothing.
Priya (AM): customer meeting is at 15:00. We should propose an interim goodwill credit to neutralize renewal risk. Ops — what's our standard for a 20m p95 regression?
Kai (SRE): rule-of-thumb from the policy doc: if impact > 10% of requests for >10m and customer SLO is 99.9 latency, start credit calc. I'll generate the error-window snapshot + sample traces.
Jordan (CSM): initial estimate: ~3% invoice credit for impacted period (based on token-weighted exposure). If Legal ok, we can offer immediate credit and commit infra remediation + an enablement walkthrough. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (AM): prefer to be proactive — offer 5% and public remediation plan. If eng prefers 3% we should split the difference and offer 4% to close. Customer is price-sensitive.
Liam (Eng): 4% is fine from Eng if we attach timeline: infra fix in 2 weeks, warmup toggle rolled out to onboarding pools by EOD tomorrow.
Kai (SRE): I'll push evidence to the evidence-bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/brightmap/2026-03-20/ and generate a signed bundle for the customer with traces + query results.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260320-72 created (priority: P2). Owner: Kai (SRE).
Jordan (CSM): action items for this thread: 1) Kai produce evidence bundle (by 14:40) 2) Liam coordinate warmup toggle (by EOD tomorrow) 3) Priya confirm customer messaging and accept credit number (ASAP) 4) Jordan send draft comms.
Priya (AM): I'll take comms. leaning to offer 4% with a note: "we've applied a one-time credit, and we've scheduled infrastructure improvements to prevent recurrence." I'll update the renewal risk flag to amber and note the remediation plan.
Jordan (CSM): perfect — I'll post the draft and tag you for final signoff 14:50. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kai (SRE): evidence bundle upload started. ETA 5m.
Jordan (CSM): closing loop — will share final credit calc and comms in this thread before the customer call.
